svg.text: slide stopped by the friendly unit

The red attacker charged into the defender’s front arc and touched its front corner. It rotates flush (step 1), then slides toward the centre of the defender’s front (step 2), but the defender’s friendly
unit stops it partway. The attacker cannot get centred, so the defender, which is not touching any other enemy unit, slides to centre itself on the attacker (step 4).
